_README: Optional. Not included in the default install. To use it, merge this file's hooks block into the project's .claude/settings.json. Enable it only if you want to enforce tests before every commit. Replace <TEST_COMMAND> with the project's test command.

hooks.command: bash -c 'read -r input; cmd=$(printf "%s" "$input" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))"); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) <TEST_COMMAND> >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Tests failed — commit blocked (dev loop convention)" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0'
